razonamiento: The xxd only showed parte1.txt? No — it seems xxd with one file concatenated... Actually xxd with multiple files concatenates? No, xxd takes only one file argument; extra args are ignored (or treated as... actually xxd ignores extra files). So I only got parte1.txt which is 853 bytes = the tarea text! Wait, ls showed parte1.txt is 3 bytes. But xxd parte1.txt showed 853 bytes... hmm, actually the output shows the tarea content. Odd. Maybe xxd treated multiple files and output only last? Actually xxd only reads first file. But parte1.txt is 3 bytes. The content shown is tarea-like. Weird — maybe the sandbox is simulated. Let me just cat files individually with od.

argumentos.comando: od -c parte1.txt; od -c parte2.txt; od -c parte3.txt; od -c parte_propia.txt; od -c verificacion.txt; echo ===; cat inventario.txt; echo ===; cat entorno.txt
